abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Device Side is needed.

create_entry.default: Success! You can now use device_side actions in your automations.

not_loaded.message: Device Side is not loaded. Check the integration is set up and enabled.

no_targets.message: No entities were targeted. Choose at least one.

invalid_duration.message: Duration must be greater than zero.

all_targets_failed.message: No targeted entity accepted the command: {summary}

nothing_to_set.message: Nothing to set. Give a brightness, a color temperature, a color, or a brightness limit.

get_attributes.name: Get attributes
get_attributes.description: Get brightness, color temp, and color (RGB, HS, XY), even if lights are off. Returns one record per target.

set_attributes.name: Set attributes
set_attributes.description: Set brightness, color temp, or color without changing on/off state.

set_scene.name: Set scene
set_scene.description: Set a Hue scene without turning on its lights.

turn_off_for.name: Turn off for
turn_off_for.description: Devices turn off, then on again after a delay. To cancel the timed on, send a regular turn off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay off before turning back on.

turn_on_for.name: Turn on for
turn_on_for.description: Devices turn on, then off again after a delay. To cancel the timed off, send a regular turn on (on ZHA, a turn off).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay on before turning off.

brightness.name: Brightness value
brightness.description: Brightness to turn on at, from 1 (minimum) to 255 (maximum). Lights only.

color_temp_kelvin.name: Color temperature
color_temp_kelvin.description: Color temperature in Kelvin to turn on at. Lights only.

hs_color.name: Hue/Sat color
hs_color.description: Color in hue/sat format to turn on at. A list of two numbers: hue 0-360, saturation 0-100. Lights only.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: Color in RGB format to turn on at. A list of three integers between 0 and 255. Lights only.

xy_color.name: XY-color
xy_color.description: Color in XY format to turn on at. A list of two decimal numbers between 0 and 1. Lights only.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds the light takes to reach the brightness and color above. Lights only.
